# STOP — please don't file security bugs as public issues

If this issue is **security-related**, do not continue filing it here.

The preferred channel is **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting**:

- Open the [Security tab](../../security) on this repo
- Click **Report a vulnerability**
- GitHub creates a private security advisory; nothing is visible to the public

The full disclosure process — what to include, response time, and the
threat model — is documented in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

If you're sure this is **not** a security issue, please use the
**Bug Report** or **Feature Request** templates instead, and close
this draft.
